SPY.title: Warren Buffett Indicator Tops 205% Amid Skyrocketing S&P 500 Valuations As Billionaire Who Predicted Dot-Com Crash 25 Years Ago Warns Of Brewing Trouble
SPY.description: The Warren Buffett Indicator has surged to 205%, indicating high market valuations. Veteran investor Howard Marks, who predicted the dot-com crash, is warning of cautionary signs in the market, including high S&P 500 valuations and reliance on a few stocks.
SPY.author: Rishabh Mishra
